question: Can the historical Binance USD-M perpetual universe be reconstructed from official public archives, including contracts that later disappeared, so a future TSMOM sleeve does not inherit current-survivor and false-shortability bias?

scope.contract_type_intent: USD-M perpetual research universe; archive discovery first, exact daily eligibility later

required_outputs: all archived USD-M symbols discoverable from monthly kline prefixes
current USD-M exchangeInfo comparison when reachable
for every ordinary archived candidate: first/last available 1d monthly archive and file count
counts proving later-disappeared perpetual contracts are retained
prohibited: no TSMOM returns or Sharpe calculation
no use of today's surviving symbols as the historical universe
no assumption that spot listing implies perpetual shortability
no filling missing contract history from a different venue
no symbol exclusion based on later performance
next_experiment_rule: Only after historical USD-M contract existence is reproducible may a separate preregistered construction audit build point-in-time daily eligibility from contract age, completed-day liquidity and actual archive availability. Funding and execution costs remain separate gates before portfolio PNL promotion.
